plan:
I'm on a spot-price electricity contract. Please schedule these appliance cycles for 2022-07-24 so that my electricity cost is as low as possible, without exceeding my household peak load limit:
- washing machine (washing_machine_1): ready from 09:30, must finish by 23:00
- washing machine (washing_machine_2): ready from 09:30, must finish by 23:00
- tumble dryer (tumble_dryer_1): ready from 09:30, must finish by 23:00
- tumble dryer (tumble_dryer_2): ready from 09:30, must finish by 23:00
- dishwasher (dishwasher_1): ready from 09:30, must finish by 23:00

results.label: Multi-Agent Pipeline
results.message: Your household's appliance schedule for July 24th is set to optimize your electricity costs! The washing machines will run at 14:15 and 15:00, while the tumble dryers will operate at 14:00 and 14:30. The dishwasher will also start at 14:00. With this schedule, your estimated maximum load will be 6.08 kW, which is comfortably within your limit of 8.00 kW.
